snippet.title: Beanland - Technical Alpha Trailer
snippet.description:
Beanland is an epic top-down action brawler! Unlock abilities and collect unique weapons, accessories, and bean colors to stand out and show off. Battle in a variety of fun locations within the Beanverse!

The game is in early development right now and we're working towards alpha, beta and beyond! Stay tuned for more information in 2023 and make sure to join our discord for more info.

We hope you enjoy this technical alpha footage of our game so far!

Read more at https://medium.com/@beannfts/beans-eoy-wrap-up-00aae7426f93
